messages:
IncidentBot: ALERT: high 99th-percentile latency for text-gen API in us-west-2 — paging oncall @here. runbook: https://runbooks/internal/text-gen-latency
Jane: oncall here, acked the page. observing P99 ~1.8s and error spikes for small-batch requests. customer-facing? any 5xxs?
Miguel: seeing elevated 5xxs from router -> model fallback chain. small fraction but correlated with latency bursts. logs: `router/fallback=1.2%` last 10m.
Ava: customer impact: one enterprise tenant reported 30s responses earlier, support ticket #5221 escalated. they're seeing degraded UX on chat flows.
Jane: thanks. mitigation: 1) switch affected routes to dedicated lower-concurrency pool 2) increase KV-cache TTL for frequent prefixes 3) temporary rate-limit backpressure for non-ESSENTIAL endpoints. doing step 1 now.
Olivia: I'm spinning up a dedicated pool, ETA ~3min. also adding a temporary routing rule to avoid model-quantized path that shows increased tail latency.
Taylor: heads-up: alert fatigue — the paging threshold for text-gen-p99 is very sensitive. We should mute noisy alerts during mitigation and fix thresholds after root cause.
Jane: agree. can someone add a PagerDuty suppression rule for the p99 alert while we stabilize? PD incident -> 98765.
Miguel: suppression done for 15m. will mark incidents in the timeline.
Ava: on customer comms: I've sent an interim message to the tenant and requested logs/steps. will update after stabilization.
Olivia: dedicated pool up, routing change applied. p99 dropped to ~520ms, 5xxs falling.
IncidentBot: Incident 2026-03-17-3524507890: mitigated, status -> monitoring.
Jane: good. postmortem action items: alert tuning, dashboard updates for retro, drilldown panels for fallback counts and kv-cache hit rate, and an eval to catch model-variant regressions.
Taylor: I can take dashboard work — plan: add a new grafana panel group for "Incident Retrospective - TextGen" with panels: P50/P95/P99 latency, error rate by route, fallback count, KV cache hit ratio, model-variant usage, token throughput. will include drilldowns to request traces and logs.
Miguel: add PromQLs we used: `sum(rate(textgen_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le,route)` and `sum(rate(textgen_fallback_total[5m])) by (route)`. KV cache: `sum(rate(kv_cache_hit_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total[5m]))`
Ava: also add an annotation stream for support tickets and PD incidents so retros align with customer impact.
Jane: alert tuning proposals: 1) change p99 trigger from 1.0s to 1.4s for standard routes, 2) add a secondary alert when fallback rate >0.5% over 5m, 3) silence per-tenant noisy alerts and route to a weekly digest for high-volume customers.
Olivia: agree. propose implementing as a temporary rule set in grafana alerting -> then sync to oncall-runbook repo.
Taylor: dashboard draft timeline: will push JSON to `grafana/dashboards/retros/` with PR referencing incident + queries. ETA this afternoon.
Miguel: can we add a low-cardinality metric: `model_variant_fallback_ratio{model=~".*-quant.*"}` so we can quickly see regressions by quantization profile?
Jane: yes, include that. ProductSupport can we get a prioritized customer-impact list for the postmortem?
ProductSupport: on it — sending the list in 10m, will flag critical SLAs.
IncidentBot: Note: don't forget to run the regression eval on the canary prompt set after dashboard and alert changes.
Jane: final: owner assignments — Taylor dashboard + alert PR, Miguel add fallback metrics + runbook snippet, Ava customer comms + postmortem draft. I'll schedule a 30m retro tomorrow with SRE, Product, and Support. thanks all. :thumbsup:
